tool: CUA in-app browser, real page controls and web Worker

rows.name: documented classifier
glob nocase fallthrough
rows.source: switch -glob -nocase LOG/a log/* - x {list shared} default {error wrong}

rows.name: default empties captures
rows.source: switch -regexp -matchvar m -indexvar ix x a {} default {};list $m $ix

rows.name: backreference and lookahead
rows.source: list [switch -regexp -matchvar m abab {(ab)\1} {set m}] [switch -regexp ac {a(?!b)} {list lookahead}]

rows.name: structured compile error
rows.source: set touched kept;catch {switch -regexp x {(} {error unreachable}} r o;list $touched [lindex [dict get $o -errorcode] 1]

rows.name: body error
rows.source: switch -regexp abc {(a)} {puts before;set touched changed;error failed}

rows.name: reset removes variables and procedures
rows.source: list [info exists touched] [info exists totals] [info procs classify]

scope: Actual rendered results, stdout, error and reset status inspected after each action. Native values checked independently afterward. Import/download, cancellation/timeout, mobile layout and browser console logs not rerun or inspected.
